captain.asks: Place the gods' thrones small in a vast columned hall, then let Zeus and Athena rise inside that order.
diagnosis: Hall is built from empty colonnades: no ring, no seated gods, the assembly never appears.
Zeus exists only as one strong close-up; Athena is three different women, one in a motor helmet.
A stranger sees architecture and faces, not a council; the vacant seat of Poseidon is never legible.

shots.seen: Round marble hall interior, columns, ornate urns, no figures
shots.why: Right hall, right light; but the ring of seated gods is absent, so it is a set, not a council.
#5 shows a row of figures under an arch: the only filled seats on the row; colonnade is empty.

shots.seen: White carved pedestal block in flat light, locked frame
shots.why: Empty stone object reads as a vacant seat; the words of Aegisthus get no image, which is acceptable.

captain22.asks: Hold the threshold axis: archer in the doorway, the hall seen from behind him, Antinous's cup on the line of fire.
diagnosis: No archer, no bow, no doorway figure ever appears; the axis the sign demands is never built.
Modern domestic props (percolator, light switch, laid dinner tables) turn the slaughter into a catalogue.
